items.title: Royal Air Maroc has signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip pilots across its fleet with AvioBook Flight, an Electronic Flight Bag platform designed to streamline flight
items.summary: Royal Air Maroc has signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip pilots across its fleet with AvioBook Flight, an Electronic Flight Bag platform designed to streamline flight workflows, support fuel optimisation and improve coordination between crews and ground teams. The deal comes as the Moroccan carrier targets a fleet of 200 aircraft by 2037, placing greater emphasis on operational systems that can support growth.
